newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Text of Cambodian message to ASEAN mediators.
newsitem.headline: Text of Cambodian message to ASEAN mediators.

text.p: Following is the text of a letter addressed individually to the foreign ministers of Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines from Cambodian Foreign Minister Ung Huot welcoming their ASEAN mediation in Cambodia's political crisis.
The letter was faxed on Tuesday from Phnom Penh to Kuala Lumpur, where the foreign ministers of the Association of South East Asian Nations have been meeting.

On behalf of His Excellency Samdech Hun Sen, Second Prime Minister of the Royal Government of Cambodia, I have the pleasure to reconfirm to Your Excellency (the individual ministers) that Cambodia welcomes ASEAN role in helping to restore political stability in the country.
Therefore I would like to invite Your Excellency...to come to Cambodia at a date convenient to Your Excellencies, if possible this week.
Please accept, Your Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration and my personal esteem.
